Usage: rhythm-sightread demo [--keep] [-o <file>]... [--open] [--json] [-q] [--fail-on <level>]

Reviews three updates of built-in example packages: a routine plugin update, a
plugin update in the pattern of the 2025 Essential Plugin takeover and an npm
update that adds an install script and a typosquatted dependency. A server on
127.0.0.1 publishes them the way WordPress.org and npm do, so the demo runs the
real review with no network. Nothing is installed and no package code runs.
--keep keeps the archives, the cache and the example site in a folder under
TMPDIR and prints where and what to run on them. -o writes the report to a file
as a review does; --open opens the HTML one. --json, -q and --fail-on work as in
a review, so "demo --fail-on high" shows the CI path: it exits 1 because two
updates are on HOLD. The other review flags (--path, --offline, --to and the
rest) don't apply to the built-in packages.

Flags:
  --fail-on <level>     exit 1 on a finding at or above this level: none, info,
                        low, medium, high or critical
  --json                print the rhythm-sightread/v1 JSON report instead of the
                        terminal one
  --keep                keep the generated archives, cache and site and print
                        their folder
  --no-color            no color (NO_COLOR does the same)
  --open                open the HTML report in the browser when done
  -o, --output <file>   also write the report to this file (repeatable; .json,
                        .md, .html or .sarif)
  --plain               no color or symbols (also when stdout is not a terminal)
  -q, --quiet           verdicts and findings only

Examples:
  rhythm-sightread demo
  rhythm-sightread demo --keep
  rhythm-sightread demo -o review.html --open
  rhythm-sightread demo --fail-on high -q
